knight-errant-a#0.notes: Knight Errant: open-faced helmet with crimson plume, moustache, crimson cape and surcoat with gold cross, sword raised, on a chestnut horse with a cream mane; reads as a mounted hero, distinct from the Knight unit (white horse, caparison, lance); hooves lowest

revenant-a#0.notes: Revenant: ivory skull knight with violet eyes in a bronze-rimmed iron helm with a near-black plume and violet-trimmed cape, sword raised, on an ivory skeleton horse; Restless palette; reads as a mounted undead hero at 1:1 on light and dark; hooves lowest

warlord-a#0.notes: Warlord: lime goblin with a hazard yellow spiked tin helmet, sand-buff fur cape and a raised cleaver on a slate-grey war boar with cream tusks; Horde palette; the boar's mass and tusks separate it from the Wolf Rider; hooves lowest

enchanter-a#0.notes: Enchanter: golden-haired enchantress in a crimson pointed hat and crimson and cream gown with a star wand on a white unicorn with a gold horn and crimson saddle cloth; Realm crimson and gold; reads as a magic hero, not the Knight Errant; hooves lowest

mortician-a#0.notes: Mortician: deadpan undertaker in a tall top hat with a violet band, black frock coat and a bronze hand bell on a grey donkey with a black plume; living face (tan rather than pale, accepted); Restless near-black and violet; distinct from the Revenant by hat and donkey; hooves lowest

weatherwitch-a#0.notes: Weatherwitch: old lime goblin with white hair under a tin pot hat with a lightning rod, hazard yellow shawl and a sparking lantern on a sand-buff goat with curly horns; Horde palette; distinct from the Warlord by mount and hat; hooves lowest

revenant-portrait-a#0.notes: Revenant portrait: ivory skull with violet eyes under a bronze-rimmed iron helm with a near-black plume, iron pauldrons and a violet-trimmed cape; matches the map sprite; reads at 48 px on light and dark

warlord-portrait-a#0.notes: Warlord portrait: lime goblin face with huge ears and a toothy grin under a spiked hazard yellow tin helmet, sand-buff fur collar; matches the map sprite and the Pulp Wars warboss portrait scale; reads at 48 px

knight-errant-portrait-a#0.notes: a small whole figure with legs, not a head-and-shoulders bust; face too small at 48 px (fixed by the bust edit)

knight-errant-portrait-a-bust#1.notes: near-identical to #0 (one shading row differs); #0 kept

weatherwitch-portrait-a#0.notes: Weatherwitch portrait: lime goblin crone with white hair under a tin pot hat with a sparking lightning rod and a shawl (orange-yellow rather than hazard yellow, and violet irises; accepted, both small); matches the map sprite; reads at 48 px

nutcracker-a#0.notes: Nutcracker: toy-soldier nutcracker with white whiskers and rosy painted wooden face under a tall black shako with a gold cord and pink plume, candy-cane red coat with gold epaulettes, candy-cane raised, on an icing-white rocking horse with red stripes, pink mane and candy-cane rockers; faces south-east; the rockers are the lowest thing; face smaller than the Knight Errant's but the shako, whiskers and rocking horse read at 1:1 on light and dark

nutcracker-b#0.notes: orange pumpkin-like scowling head, not a painted nutcracker face and not cute; muddled stripes on the horse

nutcracker-c#0.notes: faces south-west (horse head to the left), against the south-east facing rule; would need a mirror, which is forbidden
